what: Decision 1: payment methods are card and cash
Decision 2: VAT included in the price only, no separate line
Decision 3: returns without a receipt are refused
Refunds: the cashier chooses, per return, card or cash from the drawer, whatever the original payment method
Rounding: a discounted price is rounded down to the cent, in the customer's favour (19.99 at 30 % is 13.99)
Returns: over all returns of a sale, an article cannot come back more times than it was bought
Backlog signed off: tickets 001 to 008, ACCEPTANCE numbers kept, 003/004 and 005/006 stay separate
Node limit: the agent may run 5 minutes before the node cuts it
Node folder: the agent may touch only app
Node report: an agent that ends without a report is red
Rounds: two rounds back to the worker before a person decides
Reviewer may block: tests, lint and design
Merge: a person reads the pull request and presses merge
